title: Salinity disturbance and recovery of a thermophilic hydrogen-producing community in a continuous food-waste dark fermentation reactor: 16S rRNA gene (DNA) and 16S rRNA (RNA) amplicon time series
description: Time-series 16S rRNA gene (DNA) and 16S rRNA (RNA-derived cDNA) amplicon sequencing of a thermophilic (50 degrees C) continuous stirred-tank reactor (HRT 10 h) producing hydrogen from food waste. The reactor was operated through a salinity sequence of 1.0, 2.0 and 3.5% NaCl, a starvation period, and a return to 2.0 and 1.0% NaCl (15 cycles per phase). DNA-based libraries cover every cycle (78 time points); RNA-based libraries cover 22 selected time points. Two libraries (separate extractions from separate tubes of the same sample) were sequenced per time point on an Illumina MiSeq (2 x 301 bp; V4 region, primers 515F/806R).
